correctness.rationale: The exact Apéry decomposition gives (1-x^a)P(x)=sum x^i-sum x^{bi}; reducing mod x^m-1 proves the cyclic count differences. The classical genus fixes the additive constant. Each interval difference is a floor carry count minus the number of marks from a permutation of m residues, proving the ceiling-quarter bound. Diagonal residues give R_m(s)=ceil((s-1)(m-s)/m), with explicit unit witnesses for every m. A standalone checker matched 10,743 direct gap sets, 835,733 residue pairs and every witness modulus 2..180. These checks support, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Prior work resolves only whether the gap residues are exactly equal. This theorem gives all counts via an O(m)-length cycle and proves a uniform size-independent discrepancy bound across arbitrarily large coprime generators, with near-sharp construction for every modulus and exact optimality for infinitely many moduli. The object is the natural gap residue distribution and the statistic is a motivated quantitative refinement, not a one-off finite table.
